description: Four inputs mixed independently into four separate outputs, each output having its own column of level knobs, main level and polarity switch

params.text: Sets how much of its row's input reaches that column's mix; it attenuates only, or attenuates and inverts, depending on that column's polarity switch
In the UNIPOLAR position that column's four knobs run from silence to full; in the BIPOLAR position they run from fully inverted through silence at the centre to full
Sets the level of that column's output, from silence at one end of its travel to full at the other

inputs.text: Carries row A into every column's mix; with nothing patched here a steady 10V is used, so the A knobs work as a voltage source
Carries its row into every column's mix

outputs.text: The four inputs summed through that column's knobs and scaled by its output level knob, clamped to 12V either way

notes: a column's O/L lamp lights whenever that column's mix passes 10V, and the output is clamped at 12V either way
every knob starts at zero, so nothing reaches a column's output until that column's level knobs and its output level are turned up
this module is monophonic: only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read, and every output carries a single channel
